name: Question 5
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x={t}^{2}+1,\,y={t}^{3},\,t\in [0,2].
$$

What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $x$-axis?

Question 5
?

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=t2+1,y=t3,t∈[0,2]. What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
2π∫02(t2+1)4t2+9tdt
b
4π∫02t4t3+t2+1dt
c
2π∫02t33t4+2dt
d
2π∫02t49t2+4dt
e
4π∫02t33t3+2tdt
